senses.gloss: (cmp. מְגוּרָה Hag. II, 19) granary, threshing floor; harvesting season.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 10:1">Pesik. R. s. 10</cite> <he>הרי הג׳ בא</he> when harvesting comes.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 10:1">Ib.</cite> <he>באתה הג׳</he> when harvest time came.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 10:1">Ib.</cite> <he>ומשיירים את החטים לג׳</he> and they reserved the wheat for storage; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 2:6">Midr. Till. to Ps. II</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 83">Gen. R. s. 83</cite>, end; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:3">Cant. R. to VII, 3</cite> <he>עד שתבוא הג׳</he>; (<he>נכנסו אל הג׳</he>) <he>באו לג׳</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 8:27">Tosef. B. Mets. VIII, 27</cite>; Y. ib. 11ᵈ <he>גּוֹרְנוֹ</he> his store of pottery.

<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:5">Maasr. I, 5</cite> <he>איזהו גָּרְנָן למעשרות</he> (comment. <he>גּוֹרְנָן</he>) what is their harvesting time for making them liable to tithes?—Pl. <he>גְּרָנוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:5:1">Y. Peah I, 16ᶜ</cite> bot.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (cmp. כְּרִי a. כֵּירָה) circle, meeting, court-room, court (v.
units: <cite ref="I Kings 22:10">I Kings XXII, 10</cite>). Pesik. R. l. c.; v, <cite ref="A02406"><he>אִסְטְרוֹנְגִּילוֹן</he></cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 4:3">Snh. IV, 3</cite>.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:11">Koh. R. to I, 11</cite> the Lord will be seated <he>כבג׳</he> as in a court; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 11:6">Lev. R. s. 11</cite> end <he>כג׳</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 5:12">Ex. R. s. 5</cite> the Lord will seat the elders of Israel <he>כג׳</he> as the Sanedrin used to be seated.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 5:12">Ib.</cite> it is the habit of kings (councils) <he>לישב כג׳ עגולה</he> (read <he>בג׳</he>) to sit in a round court-room; <cite ref="Chullin 5a:2">Ḥull. 5ᵃ</cite> (ref. to II Kings l. c.) <he>ג׳ ממש וכ׳</he> a real court,—<he>אלא כי ג׳</he> but it means like the court (of the Sanedrin, ref. to Snh. l. c.).

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:11:1">Cant. R. to V, 11</cite> <he>גָּרְנָהּ של תורה</he> the gathering for studying the Law (<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19">Lev. R. s. 19</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 964:10">Yalk. Prov. 964</cite> <cite ref="T00844"><he>רִנָּה</he></cite>). Cmp. <cite ref="A00444"><he>אִדְּרָא</he></cite>.
